answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before trading: one identity, one deposit, slashed on proven fraud. A Sybil farm must then fund thousands of deposits, so attack cost scales with size instead of staying near zero. Reputation earned over time becomes a relic the agent guards — a long-lived history is worth more than a fresh jade-token identity, so attackers cannot burn and respawn identities for free.
